info.title: CloudThinker Public API
info.description: Public API v1. Every path names its workspace, or its organization for organization reports. IDs are UUIDs. Lists page with `limit` and `cursor`. Writes take `Idempotency-Key`. A write runs at once when the token's scopes allow it. Clients ask their person first for operations marked `x-confirm`.

post.summary: Ask CloudThinker: start an agent run, or continue a conversation.
post.description: Starts an agent run with your rights and returns at once with `status: pending`. Poll `chat.runs.get` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `required_approval`. Runs cost credits. Agent tool calls inside the run go through the workspace Approval mode.

post.summary: Answer an approval request: approve or deny it as yourself.
post.description: Approves or denies one pending approval request with your rights. Use a personal access token or your own sign-in; service account and MCP tokens are refused. You cannot answer a request you started, and a deny needs a reason. Only pending requests can be answered. After a Chat request is answered the conversation resumes, so its status can still read `pending` for a moment.

post.summary: Create an event endpoint: subscribe an HTTPS address to signed events.
post.description: Returns the signing secret once. Each delivery is a POST with `CloudThinker-Event-Id`, `CloudThinker-Event-Type` and `CloudThinker-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`, where `v1` is HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<body>` keyed by the secret.

get.summary: List event endpoints: every subscription in the workspace.
get.description: Newest first. Secrets are never returned.

get.summary: Get an event endpoint: its address, events and state.
get.description: Secrets are never returned.

patch.summary: Update an event endpoint: change its address, events, description or state.
patch.description: Send only the fields to change. Set `enabled` to false to pause deliveries.

delete.summary: Delete an event endpoint: stop deliveries and remove their history.

get.summary: List deliveries: recent events sent to an endpoint and their outcome.
get.description: Newest first. A delivery that does not get a 2xx answer is retried with backoff for about a day, eight attempts in all.

post.summary: Send a test event: deliver a signed `ping` to the endpoint.
post.description: The test event has no `data`. Follow its outcome in `events.deliveries.list`.

post.summary: Start an investigation: run root cause analysis on an incident.
post.description: Returns at once with the run. Poll `resolve.investigations.get` until `status` is `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`, then read `resolve.incidents.investigation`. Answers 409 while a run is already active and 422 for an incident grouped under a parent.

get.description: Use an `id` from `fixes.fixes.list`.

post.summary: Mark a fix as applied: record that the remediation was carried out.
post.description: Only for `incident_remediation` fixes; others answer 422. Answers 409 when the fix is already done or dismissed.

post.summary: Dismiss a fix: record that the remediation will not be carried out.
post.description: Only for `incident_remediation` fixes; others answer 422. Answers 409 when the fix is already done or dismissed.

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret: issue a new one and keep the old one valid for 24 hours.
post.description: Returns the new secret once. For 24 hours each event carries two `v1=` signatures in `CloudThinker-Signature`, one per secret, so receivers can switch without dropping events. Rotate again only after the receiver uses the new secret.

post.summary: Send a delivery again: queue a delivered or failed delivery for a fresh round of attempts.
post.description: Use it after fixing the receiver. The delivery keeps its `event_id`, so a receiver that deduplicates on it stays safe. A pending delivery answers `409` `event_delivery_pending`.

bearer.description: CloudThinker token: a personal access token `ct_pat_…` (fine-grained scopes, created in Settings) or an OAuth access token `ct_oat_…` (1 hour, from the OAuth flow). Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Scopes have the form `module:resource:read|write`; write includes read.
